title: GreatIronAxe
description:
adds a GreatIron Axe

made by me! (droacy)
body:
This is my first mod and i will say im pretty happy about it!

This mod adds a weapon made by me alone called the greatironaxe, its obtainable in survival and creative.

you can find the crafting recipe and the way to repair it under the images.

hope you enjoy :)
